overall: The AG found neither board violated the Open Meeting Law: the minutes were no longer withheld under the OML, and the AG lacks authority to rule on whether the privilege claim was valid.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the boards improperly invoked attorney-client privilege to redact January 11, 2016 executive session minutes after the lawsuit ended.
allegations.key_passage: Because the executive session minutes are no longer being withheld from the public under the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation of that law.

allegations.summary: Complainant argued the attorney-client privilege was waived because third parties attended the executive session, so the redactions were improper.
allegations.key_passage: but does not give us the authority to determine whether the Boards' assertion of the attorney-client privilege was justified.
